title: Café de soja (Roasted Soy ‘Coffee’ Powder)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: A kilogram of soy sorted, wiped with a damp cloth, roasted in a pan to a dark colour, ground to remove husks, winnowed and ground in a mill — a coffee substitute made only from soy.
longDesc: p. 38 of the October 2023 recipe book describes soy coffee as a product made only from soy, in ‘6 steps’. A kilogram is weighed and sorted, wiped with a damp cloth, roasted in a pan ‘until a dark colour is obtained’, cooled, ground to remove the husks, winnowed, and the roasted grains ground in a mill. THE BOOK PRINTS NO BREWING METHOD: the ratio of powder to water and how to prepare the drink are absent, as are the roasting time and temperature. The description says 6 steps but the extraction shows more fragments; not reconciled.
steps: Weigh 1 kg of soy and sort the grain.
Wipe the grains with a damp cloth.
Roast in a pan until a dark colour is obtained. Cool.
Grind to remove the husks. Winnow.
Grind the roasted grains in a mill to a powder.
chefTips: The only printed cue is a dark colour on roasting.
The book gives no brewing ratio — brew the powder as you would any roasted-grain infusion and note the amounts you use.
Roast time and temperature are not printed.
commonMistakes: Roasting too fast so the beans burn.
Skipping the winnowing and leaving husks.
Expecting a ratio from the book.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Café de soja’ (p. 38). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 20, prep and cook are placeholders; nutrition is a rough per-serving figure for a small amount of powder, not from the book. Method TWO-PASS on the visible text (the extraction carried a typo ‘pelliculer’ as printed).
ABSENT: roasting time and temperature; brewing method and ratio. The description says 6 steps; the extraction shows more fragments.
